messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — multiple eu-west1 edge nodes are failing model pulls. requests to model-registry.s3.redwood-internal return 502/503 from Envoy sidecar. anyone seeing this?

Alex Chan: saw alerts for high 502s earlier from the egress gateway. Gateway seems to be proxying through a corporate forward proxy + our envoy sidecar chain. suspecting double-SNAT / SNI rewrite. quick curl from a node shows: 

```
curl -v https://model-registry.s3.redwood-internal/path/model.tar.gz
* Connected to 10.10.10.5 (10.10.10.5) port 443
> GET /path/model.tar.gz HTTP/1.1
> Host: model-registry.s3.redwood-internal
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< server: envoy
< date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:23:01 GMT

```

Jordan Li: Gateway logs show TLS handshake failures to upstreams due to SNI mismatch: upstream sees SNI of the gateway fqdn instead of model-registry host. Upstream rejects client cert (we use mTLS) because CN doesn't match.

Linh Nguyen: That would explain model pulls failing but regular HTTP calls passing. Model registry enforces strict SNI+client cert. If our egress chain rewrites SNI or terminates TLS, the registry rejects.

sre-oncall: Confirmed autoscaler also flapped — it couldn't reach the metadata endpoint intermittently because egress rules routed metadata calls through the gateway. impact: a couple of nodepools didn't scale and RunJobs timed out.

Maya Patel: tl;dr: sidecar -> egress-gateway -> corporate proxy chain. Somewhere we strip/preserve SNI incorrectly and SNAT is changing source identity. Model fetcher is failing auth.

Alex Chan: immediate mitigation options:
- add explicit egress cluster in the sidecar that sets "tls_context" passthrough for model-registry.s3.redwood-internal so SNI and client certs pass through untouched
- or whitelist model-registry CIDRs on the egress gateway so requests bypass corporate rewrite
- patch ext_authz filter on gateway to skip auth for service-account=model-fetcher

Example sidecar egress snippet we used in the canary: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter  # simplified
metadata:
  name: allow-s3-registry-pass-through
spec:
  workloadSelector:
    labels: { app: model-fetcher }
  configPatches:
  - applyTo: CLUSTER
    patch:
      operation: MERGE
      value:
        name: cluster-s3-registry
        connect_timeout: 1s
        type: ORIGINAL_DST
        lb_policy: CLUSTER_PROVIDED
        tls_context: { sni: "model-registry.s3.redwood-internal", common_tls_context: { tlsCertificates: [] } }
```

Jordan Li: For the gateway, on short notice we can push a rule to preserve original destination / SNI. Envoy has a `use_original_dst`/ORIGINAL_DST cluster type we can leverage so gateway doesn't terminate TLS for that host. Also update iptables on gateway nodes to avoid SNAT-ing already-proxied traffic (masquerade only external egress, not service mesh internal).

ops-bot: Note: Rolling deploy of egress-gateway patch scheduled: canary eu-west1 -> 2 nodes, start 14:40 UTC.

Linh Nguyen: I pushed a canary patch at 14:42 UTC to add the pass-through cluster and whitelist for the model-registry CIDRs. Quick smoke: `kubectl exec -it model-fetcher-abc -- curl -I https://model-registry.s3.redwood-internal/path/model.tar.gz` now returns `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`.

Maya Patel: Nice. Can you paste the exact whitelist CIDRs + the envoy filter id so I can update the runbook?

Linh Nguyen: Whitelist CIDRs: 34.207.12.0/24, 34.207.13.0/24 (internal S3 VPC egress range). Envoy filter id: allow-s3-registry-pass-through-v2.

Alex Chan: Follow-ups:
- add a regression test in CI that deploys a tiny model-fetcher and validates SNI-preserving egress to model-registry
- update docs on egress patterns: when using mTLS/SNI upstreams, enable pass-through or whitelist in egress gateway
- schedule a config cleanup to remove the temporary whitelist after we complete a longer-term solution (policy delta).

Jordan Li: Also audit ext_authz on the gateway: some rules were matching by hostname wildcard and catching model-registry because upstream cert mismatch triggered a fallback route. We'll tighten that.

Maya Patel: Monitoring note: setting an alert on model-fetch failures and on egress-gateway 502 rate > 0.5% for 5m in eu-west1.

sre-oncall: Marking incident: INC-20260311-01, priority P2. Recording root cause candidate: egress proxy chain causing SNI rewrite and double-SNAT, breaking mTLS to internal model registry.

Linh Nguyen: After the canary, eu-west1 model pulls are green. Rolling to remaining nodes now.

Maya Patel: Great work team :thumbsup: Please update the runbook with the fix steps and schedule a postmortem to decide whether to prefer passthrough clusters vs CIDR whitelists long-term.
